WHAT THIS TOOL ACTUALLY DOES

Less record hunting. More informed research.

A pest control company can narrow down relevant buildings in its service area, inspect the underlying record, and look up the registered manager. BlockSignal brings those steps together. You still decide whether each building is worth pursuing.

01

Match your service area

Choose your trade and ZIP code. Results rank buildings by matching open records, not by their likelihood of buying.

02

Verify before saving

Read the actual violation. Confirm the owner or managing agent using HPD Online and a current business source. Registered mailing addresses are not verified sales contacts.

03

Record your next step

Save the building with a qualification note. Export the shortlist with sources and the contacts you reviewed. No outreach is sent by this app.

A prototype, with a business hypothesis to test

You could use this for your own prospect research or offer manually verified research reports to local service businesses. The underlying NYC data is free. Whether the saved time and better qualification are worth paying for has not been validated.

No payments, customer accounts, automated outreach, or guaranteed leads are included.

BlockSignal · Independent tool. Not affiliated with NYC or HPD.Shortlists are stored locally on your browser.
